name: pre-sign transaction policy conformance
from: An agent has a normalized unsigned Base transaction and a declared policy, but does not know whether signing would conform to every policy clause at an exact block anchor.
to: Before any signature, the agent has a deterministic independently replayable receipt with transaction and policy digests, chain and block identity, per-clause pass, fail, or escalate dispositions, an overall verdict, evidence references, and replay instructions.
cost: Bounded computation, state observation, evidence retention, and review attention measured and booked by the enterprise.
otherwise: The agent signs without an independently reproducible policy answer, manually reconstructs one, or refuses the transaction because assurance is unavailable.
authorityBoundary: read-only; no credentials, custody, signing, broadcast, or state mutation
